svg.title: GitHub: repository, issue and pull request tools from GitHub's MCP server
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the GitHub capability connects to GitHub's hosted MCP server at api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ with a bearer token, and the model sees the server's tools under the github_ prefix, such as github_get_me. Your auth function returns the token for each run from its deps. The toolsets, read_only and lockdown options are sent to the server as X-MCP headers, and read_only also drops any tool the server does not mark read-only.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
